exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) except for patients with Gilbert's syndrome, who are included if total bilirubin is < 3 × ULN or if direct bilirubin is < 1.5 × ULN.
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST), alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤2.5 × ULN. For those with hepatic metastases, AST and ALT ≤ 5 ×ULN.

Measured or calculated (determined by the Cockcroft-Gault equation) serum creatinine clearance (CrCl) ≥ 60 mL/min (glomerular filtration rate can be alternative to CrCl) for adult patients or serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 x ULN; or if serum creatinine > 1.5 x ULN, then serum creatinine clearance (CrCl) ≥ 50 mL/min (estimated by Cockcroft-Gault formula or other appropriate formula) for pediatric patients.
Eastern cooperative oncology group (ECOG) performance status 0-2.

Clinically significant heart disease such as congestive heart failure requiring treatment (NYHA class III or IV), left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < 50% as determined by MUGA scan or echocardiogram (ECHO)
exclusions.threshold: LVEF < 50%; NYHA class III or IV

exclusions.source_text: Average QTcF ≥ 450 msec (males) or ≥ 470 msec (females) on screening ECG.
History/evidence of acute coronary syndromes (including myocardial infarction, unstable angina, coronary artery bypass graft (CABG), coronary angioplasty, or stenting).
Patients with known HIV infection except if:
Symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastases or primary lymphoma such as primary CNS lymphoma, leptomeningeal disease, or spinal cord compression.

Concurrent malignancy within 5 years (for AML patients, 2 years) prior to entry other than adequately treated cervical carcinoma-in-situ, localized squamous cell cancer of the skin, basal cell carcinoma, prostate cancer not requiring treatment, ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast, and superficial non-muscle invasive urothelial carcinoma (excluding T1 lesions and CIS).
